item.title: Version 1.5.1
item.changes: New Filter › Progressive Blur: drag two points on the canvas Adjustment layers over 16-bit layers now preview at full precision Smoother display of 16-bit and HDR layers 16-bit layers: 16-bit PNG, TIFF, HEIF and RAW keep full precision Convert layers between 8-bit and 16-bit from the right-click menu HDR: open EXR and .hdr images, and export EXR CMYK: proof colors and gamut warning in View › CMYK
